title: Reverse Words in a Sentence
hints: What does `str.split()` return when you call it with no arguments on a string with extra spaces?
`s.split()` gives the words with all extra whitespace removed. Reverse that list, then join it with single spaces.
To capitalise every word, the same split-transform-join pattern works: `" ".join(w.capitalize() for w in s.split())`.
